## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与修改后的行为

Describe the concrete scenario and the change.

## Validation / 验证

- State which checks were run and their results.
- For visual claims, identify the reference, camera, and project version.
- State any relevant checks not performed.

## Contribution checks / 提交检查

- [ ] Installation, dependency, or scope changes are reflected in both READMEs.
- [ ] No secrets, private paths, or assets without redistribution rights are included.
- [ ] Actual observations are distinguished from proposed methods.
